canonical_claim: For every type alpha, there is a strict well-ordering relation on alpha; equivalently, alpha admits a linear order whose strict order is well-founded.

canonical_formal_target.declaration_or_expression: forall (alpha : Type u), Nonempty { r : alpha -> alpha -> Prop // IsWellOrder alpha r }
canonical_formal_target.alternate_candidate: forall (alpha : Type u), Exists fun _ : LinearOrder alpha => WellFoundedLT alpha

domain_and_universes: An arbitrary Lean type in an arbitrary universe. Translation from set-theoretic sets to types and exact universe binders await statement freeze.
conclusion: There exists a relation on alpha satisfying the strict well-order laws; equivalently there exists a LinearOrder alpha with WellFoundedLT alpha.
alternate_encodings: a nonempty subtype of relations satisfying IsWellOrder
excluded_degenerate_cases: Empty and subsingleton carriers are included, not excluded. Pre-existing orders on special carriers, well-founded partial orders, well-quasi-orders, the axiom of choice, and Zorn's lemma are not substitutes without checked transports.
